public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI's output is mediocre and the product is unprofitable.

statement.excerpt: They don’t care that the output is mediocre, that the product is unprofitable, that there is a quickly-approaching wall that generative AI can’t leap over as it runs out of training data, or that the transformer-based architecture of Large Language Models has hard limitations that are impossible to overcome.

our_interpretation: Assess only the normalized quality-and-profitability claim, not the adjacent assertions about training data or architectural limits.
The ordinary reading is that generative AI generally produces middling practical results and fails to cover its full development and operating costs.
Use January–March 2024, the latest normally reportable financial quarter before publication, as a common observation period for this combined claim.
Mediocre would require comparison with ordinary competent performance on representative practical tasks. No particular model, task mixture or quality threshold is supplied.
The financial clause names no company, currency or accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evaluations show broadly middling practical output, and comparable financial records show negative full-cost profitability for the relevant products in the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations establish consistently strong practical output, or comparable financial records establish profitability for the relevant product population in the target period.
